stock_segments.discussion_summary: Mikael presents Camurus as week's stock. The company has grown rapidly with its opioid dependence treatment (Brixadi/Buvidal). The innovation is drug delivery technology enabling sustained release over weeks/months. Key themes: platform diversification into acromegaly treatment, cancer tumor study due late 2025/early 2026 (both opportunity and risk), 2027 targets of 4.5B SEK revenue with 50% operating margins which might be reached earlier. USA launch going well with royalty partner. Not affected by manufacturing tariffs as production is in US. High valuation and research risks acknowledged.

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Discussion of historic news that Warren Buffett at age 94 will retire from Berkshire Hathaway with Greg Abel taking over. Magnus expresses admiration for Abel getting to take over the fantastic company with enormous cash flows. Mikael notes the positive influence of Buffett's philosophy of long-term investing, optimism, integrity as a role model for many investors. Discussion of Buffett's greatest contribution as the ability to use compound interest over 60+ years by using insurance float to buy stocks continuously, never having to distribute dividends, allowing compounding to work uninterrupted through a fantastic market period. The company has significant liquidity with $350 billion cash, mostly in insurance companies as collateral for insurance commitments.

De uppväckte försteg från lång tidigt och att alla fick möjlighet att investera i den här floaten. Alltid köpa aktier och att man kunde göra det under så många år. Och kunnat utnyttja ränta på ränta effekten.

quotes.speaker: Magnus Dagell

quotes.speaker: Mikael Olsson

quotes.speaker: Mikael Olsson
quotes.text: För långsiktigheten, optimismen, jobba med hög trovärdighet, att man ska ha integritet, den typen av grejer är någonting som ja men det finns säkert många på senare år som har hittat helt andra vägar in till investerande.

summary: The episode discusses Warren Buffett's historic retirement announcement from Berkshire Hathaway, with Greg Abel taking over, highlighting Buffett's compounding strategy and the enduring company culture. Mikael presents Camurus as a watch recommendation based on its drug delivery platform innovation and 2027 financial targets, while Magnus flags Novo Nordisk for its attractive valuation despite growth challenges. The hosts also discuss real estate sector challenges (Castellum, Balder) amid rate cuts and office vacancies, Rheinmetall's dramatic run-up ahead of earnings, and upcoming macro events including Fed and Riksbank decisions.
key_takeaways: Buffett's greatest contribution was uninterrupted compounding using insurance float over 60+ years
Camurus: Watch recommendation based on drug delivery platform innovation and potential to hit 2027 targets early, but high valuation and research risks
Novo Nordisk: Very attractive valuation (P/E 17/14, PEG 3) but watch for guidance cuts amid volume/price dynamics
Real estate sector (Castellum, Balder) facing challenges with office vacancies and CEO transition concerns at Castellum
Macro week ahead with Fed and Riksbank decisions amid uncertainty around tariffs and interest rates
